props.name: symbols
props.description: What can land. Any short strings — emoji read best.

props.name: result
props.description: Force a result. Omit and it picks one at random.

props.name: onSettle
props.description: Called once every reel has stopped.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds the first reel spins. Each later one adds `stagger`.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Milliseconds between one reel stopping and the next.
